correctness.rationale: Orthogonal Walsh characters on the sixteen even-parity five-bit words give the explicit induced-edge identity e(U)=m²/4-3m/2+(1/8)sum_{i<j}b_ij². At ten vertices this gives e>=10, excluding induced forests. At nine, odd character sums force e>=8 and equality characterizes the 80 sets consisting of a complete coordinate halfspace plus one opposite vertex. The only competing odd square-sum partitions of 53 are ruled out by halfspace intersection and parity. Each survivor induces a subdivided four-leaf star. The complete optimum family gives 10 K8 for exchange one or two; direct intersection cases establish 23 neighbors, 920 edges, and distance counts (1,23,48,8) for exchange three. Independent exact programs reproduce all finite values from complete enumerations and distinct graph realizations. Limits: only the five-regular Clebsch graph and simultaneous exchanges.

originality.rationale: The exact eighty-set geometric classification, ten-clique one-exchange fragmentation, three-exchange connectivity threshold and uniform diameter-three profile are not implied by the graph-parameter and hypercube-bootstrap results examined. published-finding corpus semantic searches for the object, aliases, induced forests, decycling sets, percolation and reconfiguration produced no direct covering claim. In particular the closest Clebsch-specific result concerns the independence complex, not feedback vertex sets. The strongest directly related FVS reconfiguration results have planar or subcubic hypotheses, which the nonplanar 5-regular Clebsch graph does not satisfy. The accessible 2015 hypercube-percolation primary text concerns ordinary cubes, not the folded five-cube. value.rationale: The minimum feedback-vertex-set classification is a natural complete invariant for the canonical strongly regular Clebsch graph, not an arbitrary subset census. The Fourier argument explains why all maximal induced forests have the same subdivided-star form. The sharp jump from ten disconnected eight-cliques to diameter-three connectivity at simultaneous exchange three is structurally motivated by the geometry of coordinate hyperplanes, while token sliding fragments further into forty edges. The equivalent four-neighbor infection interpretation connects optimization and propagation rather than merely recounting a known size.
